notes.title: Simplified Chinese Added!!
notes.content:
Hey, it took a lot of time (and money), but we finally added Simplified Chinese to A Promise Best Left Unkept. Almost all 450k words have been translated. There is one small file that is missing (in the Hero Fallen ending), but it's almost nothing. I'll be adding it soon.

Still, since it's a lot of work, there is bound to be some text that is missing here and there. Or maybe some bugs have been introduced without my meaning. If you find anything, please do let me know.

Also, just a reminder that I'm still working on the Aya Edition of A Promise Best Left Unkept. It should reach its first ending next month. So if you're interested, do check it out! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2479300/A_Promise_Best_Left_Unkept__Aya_Edition/

In any case, take care!

notes.title: Aya Edition, the alternative version of APBLU, just released on Early Access!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2479300/A_Promise_Best_Left_Unkept__Aya_Edition/

Hi everyone!

Just want to let you guys know that my next game, A Promise Best Left Unkept - Aya Edition just released on Steam Early Access!

A Promise Best Left Unkept - Aya Edition is an alternative version of A Promise Best Left Unkept that stands on its own two feet (no need to have played the original). Aya is now the main heroine of this Hard NTR visual novel. With a new narrative of more than 300k+ words, new events, and characters! 

Here are a few of the features available as of V0.3.0 (not counting the common route):
-	More than 25 CG sets 
-	More than 8 sex scenes
-	More than 100k words
-	Most of the sex scenes are animated.

I'm planning to update it every month as this is my main project.

notes.title: The First Season Of Bonus Scenes Just Released As A DLC
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2612460/A_Promise_Best_Left_Unkept__Bonus_Scenes_Season_1/

Took me a bit more time than anticipated, but finally managed to release the first season of bonus scenes as a DLC.

For those who don't know, I write bonus scenes on the side while developing my projects. The scenario of every bonus scene is thought up by one member of my community and is written by me.

The first season of bonus scenes contains 6 bonus scenes and costs 1.99$. Only one of the stories in it is actually canon. So unless you really like my work and want more of A Promise Best Left Unkept, I personally think there's more than enough content in the base version of the game already. But the option is there nonetheless.

In any case, thank you all so much for purchasing my game and supporting me. The past few days have been really great!

To show my appreciation, here's a witch Hangover!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43463546/3c830ad6a8c449135ee761b3053e77f987f597f9.png[/img]
